scripts.kill:ports: powershell -Command "@(5000, 5173) | ForEach-Object { Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $_ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
